name: bollinger_ema_sar_v2
purpose: Retest the unchanged V1 setup while replacing only the overly restrictive monotonic EMA20 filter with a causal net-slope / non-lateral filter.
unchanged_from_v1: rocket rejection or body engulfing signal
higher signal low for LONG / lower signal high for SHORT
stop on candle immediately before signal

single_change_v2.name: EMA20 causal slope / non-lateral filter
single_change_v2.minimum_absolute_slope: 5% of Bollinger bandwidth over 5 closed bars
single_change_v2.sideways: NO_TRADE when the directional slope threshold is not met

comparison: Compare V2 against sealed V1 discovery results, especially number of valid trades, expectancy, PF, drawdown, direction split, pattern split, session split and filter funnel. No promotion based on win rate alone.
